name: ELU-Norm
tagline: Stabilize positive features by fixing the q/k scale.
description: Per-head parameter-free RMSNorm of q and k (FP32) with a fixed temperature of 8 precedes the ELU+1 feature map. The state is read without the φ(q)ᵀz denominator and normalized by a per-head RMSNorm with a learned gain. Attention runs in IEEE FP32 so gradients stay accurate when the state is nearly rank one.
paperTitle: Transformers are RNNs: Fast Autoregressive Transformers with Linear Attention
mechanism: S = Σφ(k)vᵀ read as φ(q)ᵀS without a denominator
Per-head output RMSNorm with gain; IEEE FP32 chunked attention
limitations: Uses NormAttention-style output normalization and fixed pre-feature q/k normalization without a learned affine map. The pilot used a documented post-hoc substitution for its final numerical check.
